relations.name: reporting_borrower_activity_daily_v1
relations.view_definition:
WITH events AS (
         SELECT reporting_borrower_loan_facts_v1.borrower_id,
            reporting_borrower_loan_facts_v1.loan_date AS activity_date,
            reporting_borrower_loan_facts_v1.original_principal AS principal_issued,
            0::numeric AS principal_returned,
            0::numeric AS interest_received,
            1::bigint AS loans_issued,
            (reporting_borrower_loan_facts_v1.borrowing_type = 'First loan'::text)::integer::bigint AS first_loans,
            (reporting_borrower_loan_facts_v1.borrowing_type = 'Repeat loan'::text)::integer::bigint AS repeat_loans,
            (reporting_borrower_loan_facts_v1.borrowing_type = 'Unavailable'::text)::integer::bigint AS unclassified_loans,
            (reporting_borrower_loan_facts_v1.loan_date IS NULL OR reporting_borrower_loan_facts_v1.original_principal IS NULL OR reporting_borrower_loan_facts_v1.borrower_id IS NULL)::integer::bigint AS invalid_events
           FROM reporting_borrower_loan_facts_v1
        UNION ALL
         SELECT l."Ref Borrowers",
            r."Payment Date",
            0::numeric AS "numeric",
            r."Principal Paid"::numeric AS "Principal Paid",
            r."Interest Paid"::numeric AS "Interest Paid",
            0::bigint AS int8,
            0::bigint AS int8,
            0::bigint AS int8,
            0::bigint AS int8,
            (r."Payment Date" IS NULL OR r."Principal Paid" IS NULL OR r."Interest Paid" IS NULL OR l."Ref Borrowers" IS NULL)::integer::bigint AS int8
           FROM olap_repayments_analytics r
             LEFT JOIN olap_loans_analytics l ON l."Row ID" = r."Ref Loans"
        )
 SELECT borrower_id,
    activity_date,
        CASE
            WHEN bool_and(principal_issued IS NOT NULL) THEN sum(principal_issued)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS principal_issued,
        CASE
            WHEN bool_and(principal_returned IS NOT NULL) THEN sum(principal_returned)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS principal_returned,
        CASE
            WHEN bool_and(interest_received IS NOT NULL) THEN sum(interest_received)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS interest_received,
    sum(loans_issued)::bigint AS loans_issued,
    sum(first_loans)::bigint AS first_loans,
    sum(repeat_loans)::bigint AS repeat_loans,
    sum(unclassified_loans)::bigint AS unclassified_loans,
    sum(invalid_events)::bigint AS invalid_events
   FROM events
  GROUP BY borrower_id, activity_date;

relations.name: reporting_borrower_directory_v1
relations.view_definition:
WITH loans AS (
         SELECT reporting_borrower_loan_facts_v1.borrower_id,
            count(*) AS loan_count,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE reporting_borrower_loan_facts_v1.is_active) AS active_loans,
            min(reporting_borrower_loan_facts_v1.loan_date) AS first_loan_date,
                CASE
                    WHEN bool_and(reporting_borrower_loan_facts_v1.outstanding_principal IS NOT NULL) THEN sum(reporting_borrower_loan_facts_v1.outstanding_principal)
                    ELSE NULL::numeric
                END AS principal,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE reporting_borrower_loan_facts_v1.loan_date IS NULL OR reporting_borrower_loan_facts_v1.original_principal IS NULL OR reporting_borrower_loan_facts_v1.outstanding_principal IS NULL OR reporting_borrower_loan_facts_v1.is_active IS NULL) AS invalid_loans
           FROM reporting_borrower_loan_facts_v1
          GROUP BY reporting_borrower_loan_facts_v1.borrower_id
        ), payments AS (
         SELECT l_1."Ref Borrowers" AS borrower_id,
            max(r."Payment Date") FILTER (WHERE r."Payment Date" <= olap_reporting_date()) AS last_payment_date,
                CASE
                    WHEN bool_and(r."Interest Paid" IS NOT NULL) THEN sum(r."Interest Paid"::numeric) FILTER (WHERE r."Payment Date" <= olap_reporting_date())
                    ELSE NULL::numeric
                END AS lifetime_interest,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE r."Payment Date" IS NULL OR r."Principal Paid" IS NULL OR r."Interest Paid" IS NULL) AS invalid_payments
           FROM olap_repayments_analytics r
             LEFT JOIN olap_loans_analytics l_1 ON l_1."Row ID" = r."Ref Loans"
          GROUP BY l_1."Ref Borrowers"
        ), names AS (
         SELECT b_1."Row ID" AS borrower_id,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(b_1."Description", ''::text), 'Unnamed borrower'::text) AS borrower_name,
            b_1."Hidden Flag" AS hidden_flag,
            count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY (COALESCE(NULLIF(b_1."Description", ''::text), 'Unnamed borrower'::text))) AS name_count
           FROM olap_borrowers_analytics b_1
        )
 SELECT b.borrower_id,
    b.borrower_name,
    b.borrower_name ||
        CASE
            WHEN b.name_count > 1 THEN ' · '::text || b.borrower_id
            ELSE ''::text
        END AS borrower_label,
    b.hidden_flag,
    COALESCE(l.loan_count, 0::bigint) AS loan_count,
    COALESCE(l.active_loans, 0::bigint) AS active_loans,
    COALESCE(l.active_loans, 0::bigint) > 0 AS has_active_loan,
    l.first_loan_date,
        CASE
            WHEN l.borrower_id IS NULL THEN 0::numeric
            ELSE l.principal
        END AS outstanding_principal,
    p.last_payment_date,
        CASE
            WHEN p.borrower_id IS NULL THEN 0::numeric
            WHEN p.invalid_payments > 0 THEN NULL::numeric
            ELSE COALESCE(p.lifetime_interest, 0::numeric)
        END AS lifetime_interest,
    COALESCE(l.invalid_loans, 0::bigint) + COALESCE(p.invalid_payments, 0::bigint) AS invalid_fact_count,
    olap_reporting_date() AS reporting_date,
    statement_timestamp() AS calculated_at
   FROM names b
     LEFT JOIN loans l USING (borrower_id)
     LEFT JOIN payments p USING (borrower_id);

           FROM olap_loans_analytics l
        )
 SELECT "Row ID" AS loan_id,
    "Ref Borrowers" AS borrower_id,
    "Loan Date" AS loan_date,
    "Close Date" AS close_date,
    "Due Date" AS due_date,
    "Principal Amount"::numeric AS original_principal,
    "Outstanding Principal" AS outstanding_principal,
    "Total Principal Received" AS principal_received,
    "Total Interest Received" AS interest_received,
    "Loan Status" = 'ยังไม่ปิดยอด'::text AS is_active,
        CASE "Loan Status"
            WHEN 'ยังไม่ปิดยอด'::text THEN 'Active'::text
            WHEN 'ปิดยอดแล้ว'::text THEN 'Closed'::text
            ELSE "Loan Status"
        END AS loan_status,
        CASE "Loan Type"
            WHEN 'กำหนดวันชำระ'::text THEN 'Fixed Due Date'::text
            WHEN 'ดอกเบี้ยรายวัน'::text THEN 'Daily Interest'::text
            WHEN 'ผ่อนชำระรายวัน'::text THEN 'Daily Installment'::text
            ELSE 'Unknown'::text
        END AS loan_type,
    "Current Daily Interest"::numeric AS daily_interest,
    "Defaulted Flag" AS defaulted,
    "Default Loss Amount"::numeric AS default_loss,
        CASE
            WHEN incomplete_dates THEN 'Unavailable'::text
            WHEN loan_sequence = 1 THEN 'First loan'::text
            ELSE 'Repeat loan'::text
        END AS borrowing_type
   FROM ranked;

routines.result: TABLE(borrower_id text, borrower_label text, hidden_flag boolean, has_active_loan boolean, active_loans bigint, loan_count bigint, first_loan_date date, last_payment_date date, outstanding_principal numeric, lifetime_interest numeric, principal_issued numeric, principal_returned numeric, interest_received numeric, loans_issued bigint, first_loans bigint, repeat_loans bigint, unclassified_loans bigint, principal_share numeric, interest_share numeric, principal_rank bigint, interest_rank bigint, invalid_fact_count bigint, reporting_date date, calculated_at timestamp with time zone)
routines.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.reporting_borrower_period_v1(p_start date, p_end date, p_population text DEFAULT 'All with loan history'::text)
 RETURNS TABLE(borrower_id text, borrower_label text, hidden_flag boolean, has_active_loan boolean, active_loans bigint, loan_count bigint, first_loan_date date, last_payment_date date, outstanding_principal numeric, lifetime_interest numeric, principal_issued numeric, principal_returned numeric, interest_received numeric, loans_issued bigint, first_loans bigint, repeat_loans bigint, unclassified_loans bigint, principal_share numeric, interest_share numeric, principal_rank bigint, interest_rank bigint, invalid_fact_count bigint, reporting_date date, calculated_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
 WITH cohort AS (
 SELECT d.* FROM public.reporting_borrower_directory_v1 d WHERE d.loan_count>0
 AND (p_population='All with loan history' OR p_population='Currently active' AND d.has_active_loan
 OR p_population='Currently inactive' AND NOT d.has_active_loan)
 AND p_start IS NOT NULL AND p_end>=p_start AND p_end<=public.olap_reporting_date()
 ), activity AS (
 SELECT a.borrower_id,
 CASE WHEN bool_and(a.principal_issued IS NOT NULL) THEN sum(a.principal_issued) END principal_issued,
 CASE WHEN bool_and(a.principal_returned IS NOT NULL) THEN sum(a.principal_returned) END principal_returned,
 CASE WHEN bool_and(a.interest_received IS NOT NULL) THEN sum(a.interest_received) END interest_received,
 sum(a.loans_issued)::bigint loans_issued,sum(a.first_loans)::bigint first_loans,sum(a.repeat_loans)::bigint repeat_loans,
 sum(a.unclassified_loans)::bigint unclassified_loans
 FROM public.reporting_borrower_activity_daily_v1 a WHERE a.activity_date BETWEEN p_start AND p_end GROUP BY a.borrower_id
 ), combined AS (
 SELECT d.*,CASE WHEN a.borrower_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE a.principal_issued END principal_issued,
 CASE WHEN a.borrower_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE a.principal_returned END principal_returned,
 CASE WHEN a.borrower_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE a.interest_received END interest_received,
 coalesce(a.loans_issued,0) loans_issued,coalesce(a.first_loans,0) first_loans,coalesce(a.repeat_loans,0) repeat_loans,
 coalesce(a.unclassified_loans,0) unclassified_loans FROM cohort d LEFT JOIN activity a USING(borrower_id)
 ), totals AS (
 SELECT c.*,CASE WHEN bool_and(c.outstanding_principal IS NOT NULL) OVER() THEN sum(c.outstanding_principal) OVER() END total_principal,
 CASE WHEN bool_and(c.interest_received IS NOT NULL) OVER() THEN sum(c.interest_received) OVER() END total_interest FROM combined c
 )
 SELECT t.borrower_id,t.borrower_label,t.hidden_flag,t.has_active_loan,t.active_loans,t.loan_count,t.first_loan_date,t.last_payment_date,
 t.outstanding_principal,t.lifetime_interest,t.principal_issued,t.principal_returned,t.interest_received,t.loans_issued,t.first_loans,t.repeat_loans,
 t.unclassified_loans,CASE WHEN t.total_principal>0 THEN t.outstanding_principal/t.total_principal END,
 CASE WHEN t.total_interest>0 THEN t.interest_received/t.total_interest END,
 row_number() OVER(ORDER BY t.outstanding_principal DESC NULLS LAST,t.borrower_id),
 row_number() OVER(ORDER BY t.interest_received DESC NULLS LAST,t.borrower_id),t.invalid_fact_count,t.reporting_date,t.calculated_at FROM totals t
$function$
routines.comment: Read-only borrower period facts: explicit Bangkok dates, current cohort, signed receipts, immutable keys. Current positions do not reconstruct past balances. No AppSheet binding.

 FROM public.reporting_borrower_activity_daily_v1 a WHERE a.activity_date BETWEEN p_start AND p_end GROUP BY a.borrower_id
 ), combined AS (
 SELECT d.*,CASE WHEN a.borrower_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE a.principal_issued END principal_issued,
 CASE WHEN a.borrower_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE a.principal_returned END principal_returned,
 CASE WHEN a.borrower_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE a.interest_received END interest_received,
 coalesce(a.loans_issued,0) loans_issued,coalesce(a.first_loans,0) first_loans,coalesce(a.repeat_loans,0) repeat_loans,
 coalesce(a.unclassified_loans,0) unclassified_loans FROM cohort d LEFT JOIN activity a USING(borrower_id)
 ), totals AS (
 SELECT c.*,CASE WHEN bool_and(c.outstanding_principal IS NOT NULL) OVER() THEN sum(c.outstanding_principal) OVER() END total_principal,
 CASE WHEN bool_and(c.interest_received IS NOT NULL) OVER() THEN sum(c.interest_received) OVER() END total_interest FROM combined c
 )
 SELECT t.borrower_id,t.borrower_label,t.hidden_flag,t.has_active_loan,t.active_loans,t.loan_count,t.first_loan_date,t.last_payment_date,
 t.outstanding_principal,t.lifetime_interest,t.principal_issued,t.principal_returned,t.interest_received,t.loans_issued,t.first_loans,t.repeat_loans,
 t.unclassified_loans,CASE WHEN t.total_principal>0 THEN t.outstanding_principal/t.total_principal END,
 CASE WHEN t.total_interest>0 THEN t.interest_received/t.total_interest END,
 row_number() OVER(ORDER BY t.outstanding_principal DESC NULLS LAST,t.borrower_id),
 row_number() OVER(ORDER BY t.interest_received DESC NULLS LAST,t.borrower_id),t.invalid_fact_count,t.reporting_date,t.calculated_at FROM totals t
$function$
